instruction: Access the side effects information for Ibuprofen.

metadata.explanation: Variation of the original Tamiflu task. User needs to search for Ibuprofen (a common pain reliever/anti-inflammatory) and navigate to its side effects page. The task maintains the same complexity level as the original - single navigation to drugs.com side effects page. Reuses existing getters (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and metrics (is_expected_url_pattern_match). Expected URLs follow the same pattern as the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic semantically and correctly verifies the instruction
Getter get_active_url_from_accessTree correctly extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly uses regex pattern matching to verify URL matches expected side effects pages
Expected URL patterns correctly capture two valid drugs.com side effects pages for Ibuprofen (main page with anchor and dedicated sfx page)
URL patterns appropriately allow optional www subdomain for flexibility
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies that user accessed Ibuprofen side effects information
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter - accesses rules["expected"] directly, which is correct for type: rule
